<<This clash is in Reverse mode only.>>

Cases

* Please add Test 5 and Validator 5 where [[A]] is a multiple of [[B]] and [[A]] ≠ [[B]].

* Please add Test 6 and Validator 6 where [[B]] is a multiple of [[A]] and [[A]] ≠ [[B]].

* Please add Test 7 and Validator 7 where [[A]] = [[B]].

* Please add Test 8 and Validator 8 where [[A]] > [[B]] and the GCD is 1.

* Please add Test 9 and Validator 9 where [[A]] > [[B]] and the GCD is greater than 1.
